translations.web: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
translations.bsb: Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
translations.kjv: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend
translations.asv: For hath any said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
